description.value: The Charlatan is a well-established gastro-pub at the corner of Commercial Drive and Grant, in the heart of one of Vancouver's most eclectic and cycling-friendly neighbourhoods. It occupies multiple levels including a south-facing, willow-fringed patio, an upper bar with 21 draught lines (heavily weighted toward BC craft breweries), a lounge, and a private downstairs den. The broad menu spans share plates, mussels, bowls, and brunch, making it a solid stop for a full meal at any time of day.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 8m; stands (2 spaces) at 20m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the business is a working gastro-pub on Commercial Drive with recent menu updates dated into 2026. OSM tags (outdoor_seating=yes, indoor_seating=yes) are corroborated by the website's description of a patio and multiple indoor spaces. The kitchen menu explicitly labels items Ve (Vegetarian), Vg (Vegan), and Gf (Gluten Free), confirming dietary options; no bike-specific amenities (parking, pump, charging, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere in the OSM tags or website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible gastro-pub with a current website and confirmed address. Located on Commercial Drive, a major cycling corridor in Vancouver, making it directly relevant to touring cyclists.
